title: Place profile
description: What one place knows about itself: the power system it sits on and the water utilities that serve it. One file per place at profiles/<place>.yaml; scripts/validate.py checks each against this schema, that the file is named for its place, that the place is a real one in places.yaml, that the system is a hand-written one, that every ring is closed, and that every `sources` and `readings` id exists.

polygon.description: A ring of [lon, lat] points. The first point repeats as the last (validate.py checks that).

name.description: The utility as it names itself.

match.description: The name a mapped water work carries for this utility on the public map. A node looks works up by it; the registry holds no points.

sources.description: Registry entries (pillar/scale/slug) the utility's figures come from.

readings.description: The readings in readings.yaml this utility serves.

notes.description: What was read about the utility, where and when.

place.description: The place's slug in places.yaml, and the name of the file.

system.description: The id of a hand-written system in systems/energy/.

rings.description: The place's own city and region areas inside the system, each a closed polygon.

notes.description: What the profile covers and what it leaves out.
